notes.title: Join us for Not a Sailor Studios Christmas!
notes.content:
[h1]Hello, everyone! As the holiday season draws near, Not a Sailor Studio Christmas is finally here! ːFriendoː[/h1]

We’re celebrating the 3rd Annual NASSMAS with 8 days of community, creativity, and surprises as we countdown to Christmas and enjoy the holiday season together. It’s our way of showing appreciation for all of you who make this community so incredible. Most of you are on the nice list at least.Expect giveaways, special reveals, and plenty of ways to get involved. We’ve got a few surprises up our sleeves, and we’re excited to share some fun things throughout the week.

[h2]DAY 1: THE BEANS (PLUSHIE) ARE BACK IN TOWN ːBeanShockː[/h2]

The official [b]Buddy Simulator 1984 Bean Plush[/b] is now available on our own Etsy shop! Now is your chance to hold the World's Greatest Dad in your own hands! We know many of you have expressed frustration with how the shipping has been handled with our previous partner, so now is the best time to get your official Bean Plush while also helping support the team directly. 

In addition to newly available Bean Plushies on our Etsy page, we also have a new holiday discount code: NASSMAS24 that will get you 20% off everything in our Etsy store! And when you order any of the stickers using this code, we'll throw in some exclusive bonus stickers while supplies last!

notes.title: 2 Year Anniversary, Xbox & PlayStation Ports, and MORE!
notes.content:
[h1][b]HAPPY 2 YEAR ANNIVERSRY BUDDY SIM![/b][/h1]

Two years ago today, we released Buddy Simulator 1984 to the world. During that time, we were so scared, stressed, and worried that all of the work we had put into that passion project of 1s and 0s would never pay off...but we couldn't be more thankful that it did. Throughout the past two years, we have garnered such an incredible community of amazing and talented fans from around the globe to love and support our little game. Buddy Sim lived and thrived because of you all. Two years later and we're still so thankful for each and every one of you! In honor of Buddy Sim turning two, we have a few ways we want to celebrate with you all!


[h2][b]BUDDY SIM 2 YEAR ANNIVERSARY ART GALLERY[/b][/h2]
[previewyoutube=Em9dttS4S0I;full][/previewyoutube]
Behold, modern art! Thank you all so much that contributed their work towards the 2 year event project! Our Graphic Designer Vince has put together a beautiful collage of Buddy Sim art for everyone to enjoy! We have also provided the Google Drive link for all of the art submitted. We will be posting the art gallery as well as the Drive link to our social medias soon! Thank you so much again for not only being a part of this community but sharing your love for it through art, crafts, music and more! 

Drive Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1P3zcdFRk5qgZJD6za0H5Ici2ROtWjpPB?usp=share_link



[h2][b]BUDDY SIM IS COMING TO PLAYSTATION & XBOX[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37298632/3768da780368c3e629e47db23b368baa6d2c0f2b.gif[/img]
We are happy to announce with the help of our wonderful publishers at Feardemic that Buddy Simulator 1984 will be launching on consoles sometime this March! We would greatly appreciate it if you could spread the word about this and especially Retweet, Like, and Comment on any Twitter and/or TikTok posts about this too! And yes, we are trying to branch out on TikTok as well! (@notasailorstudios on TikTok)
Keep an eye out for more information and the official launch date in the coming month! 


[h2][b]MORE WAYS TO CELEBRATE[/b][/h2]
In order to make sure this 2 year anniversary is the best it can be, we wanted to thank you all and celebrate in a few more ways! First, for ONE WEEK ONLY all of our merch, including the Bean plush, will be 30% off when you use the code "[b]2YEARS[/b]" at checkout. This is the lowest you will probably ever see our merch go, so grab it before they're gone! 
Merch: https://www.ownaj.com/search?type=product&q=buddy+simulator

Second, Buddy Sim is now 40% off for the next week to celebrate! If you already own the game, thank you a ton! If you don't own or even want to share with a friend, now is the perfect time while it is discounted on our birthday week!

Lastly, we wanted to do another round of giveaways, but this time ONLY on our Discord as a thank you to our most loyal, passionate, and dedicated fans. For the first time ever, four  people can win $25 Steam gift cards! That's right, FOUR big winners for $100 total in giveaways! Join our Discord to enter and chat with other fans!

Discord: https://discord.gg/notasailorstudios


Thank you all so much again and don't forget to wish your Buddy a happy birthday in game as well! Have a wonderful week everyone!

Love,

notes.title: BUDDY SIMULATOR 1984 ONE YEAR ANNIVERSARY & NEW MERCH
notes.content:
[h1][b]WE’RE BACK![/b][/h1]
Happy 2022 everyone! It’s been awhile since we’ve posted a devlog here and what better time to do so than our one year anniversary of releasing Buddy Simulator 1984 to Steam! Below we will be going over many new things including: going 40% off for our Steam Spotlight Sale, new merchandise, some info on our next game project, and a bit of a "diet" post mortem of Buddy Sim and its development process. Buckle up, you’re in for a wild read!

[h1][b]ONE YEAR ANNIVERSARY SALE AND CELEBRATION![/b][/h1]
On February 18th, 2021 we released our first full game title, Buddy Simulator 1984, to Steam. We had no idea what we were doing and what to expect, but we are so damn happy you all took this giant leap of faith with us. Buddy Sim has far exceeded our expectations on Steam and has pushed us to start brand new projects with all of the hard lessons learned along the way. We will talk more about that later in this devlog!

Buddy Simulator 1984 is now 40% OFF for the next 3 days. You aren’t going to see this high of a discount for a while so grab it while you can! Those that already played it, we thank you from the bottom of our hearts. We ask that you please leave an honest review of what you thought of the game on Steam when you get the chance! If the game undoubtedly resonated with you, we would also love it if you could share that feeling with a friend by gifting them the game! Every review and every gift helps more than you could ever know.

[h1][b]NEW MERCH AND PLUSHIES!?[/b][/h1]
By popular demand and countless “Bean plushie when” requests, we are excited to announce brand new merch and the official Bean Plushie! Unfortunately at the moment, the plushie will not be available to order until we finalize a few more details with our partner. In the meantime, check out our official store page on Ownaj where you can find new posters, stickers, shirts, and hoodies! https://www.ownaj.com/collections/buddy-simulator

We have partnered with the wonderful merch site Ownaj to create some of the most high quality and exclusive Buddy Sim merchandise we can get our hands on. There is a limited supply of each product with the sticker pack being limited to only 50! Grab them before they’re gone! While they might not be gone forever like our original batch of merch on Etsy, if you would like to see more Buddy Sim products on Ownaj, please support us and their store by clicking the link and representing Buddy Simulator by sporting a pocket friendo tee or a hoodie with all of your favorite characters!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37298632/b60a37777572ecfcbb0d8b8cd4c75c0ac4f664d5.png[/img]

[h1][b]COMMUNITY TRANSLATIONS[/b][/h1]
Translating Buddy Sim into other languages has always been a dream for us, but we could never find the time with new projects starting and other big things happening behind the scenes. Many have asked to help be a part of this process, and some have already started. One of our mods, noCruse, would like to start helping make the process a bit easier.

We want to state right off the bat that this is not our biggest priority at the moment. This will be quite a long term project with a lot of tedious effort put into it, but if you would like to be a part of it and help get Buddy Sim into your native language, please DM or ping @noCruselisch#1707 in the general chat so we can start gauging some interest before we get things more organized and moderated. 

[h1][b]OUR NEXT GAME[/b][/h1]
A lot of people have been asking what’s next for Not a Sailor Studios. I think it’s time to reveal a few things to start easing expectations while still teasing our next project for loyal fans. 

To address the elephant in the room: there are currently no plans to develop more content for Buddy Simulator 1984. We are extremely satisfied with how Buddy Sim ended and turned out that we feel it doesn’t need any more conclusion or predecessor. While we have our attention on other big things at the moment, additional Buddy Sim content in the future is never off the table.

With all that being said, we would like to confirm that things are going well for the prototype for our next game, REDACTED. You all will be happy to know that we are carrying on the horror game experience and bringing a unique game experience to you all. We will reveal more in due time! Stay tuned and enjoy this next section all about the post mortem of Buddy Simulator 1984!

[h1][b]BUDDY SIMULATOR 1984 "DIET" POST MORTEM[/b][/h1]
Working on Buddy Simulator 1984 has been such an incredible journey. For those of you that have stuck around this far, thanks a million. Without further ado, here is our project's "diet" post-mortem.

Not a Sailor Studios started alongside the release of our first game, A Game About Literally Doing Your Taxes. The game was made during a 48 hour day Game Jam, and to our surprise, the game did really well, amassing tens of thousands of downloads on itch.io, and even getting a small cult following with the help of large Youtubers such as Markiplier and Jacksepticeye. With this new following and a few generous donations by our followers to get the company off of the ground, we decided to tackle our next project, Buddy Simulator 1984. The goal of this project was to complete a fully fleshed out game and sell it on Steam with just the four of us.

The project originally started before AGALYT. Brandon Hesslau (concept creator, programmer, and sound designer/musician), Vince Weiss (artist/graphic designer), and Jake Breit (text adventure writer) had worked on a good chunk of the “demo” portion of our game, mainly focusing on the early relationship you build with your buddy. The project was eventually shelved, and didn’t pick up steam again until Josh Eckhart (Producer/Community manager), and DeMarco Scarnegie (artist/animator) were brought onto the team to what we now know as Not a Sailor Studios. While Jake Breit didn’t stick around as a member of the team, we still kept a majority of his work, with his permission, in the project since he knocked the text adventure section out of the park.
While developing the game in its early stages, one of the things we had talked about was that there weren't a whole lot of games that developed as you played it. To achieve this, we wanted the narrative and visual style of the game to get progressively more complicated as the relationship with you and your buddy grew until eventually collapsing. While this was the core idea for the entirety of the project’s development, we took on a rather improvised style of writing. DeMarco for example, would design characters before they were even written into the story, and Josh would mold them into the game's universe. Another example of this was how the “endings” for the game weren’t concrete until they were being developed and coded by Brandon–ideas often being thrown around as sections were in development. This was both beneficial to how the story’s chaotic and unpredictable nature unfolded, and detrimental to the team’s sense of scope as we had no clear direction for what to work on and how long it would take. Regardless of this approach, it proved to be more of a positive than a negative given the game's outcome, but it’s definitely something we plan on discussing further and getting under control with our next project.

Because this game was developed during Covid, we often found ourselves spending a lot of time in our bedrooms while working on this game. To stay in touch, we often had to hop in calls together to get work done, pushing one another to work on the project with no real concrete work schedules. Working in one space for so long could sometimes feel cramped. On top of working on the project, Vince and Brandon also had to worry about finishing up their Senior year of college, often needing to balance their work and school lives
As the project was nearing its completion, and after a couple delays, our team had begun to face our next greatest challenge: release. Not only was the pressure of releasing a product into the wild completely terrifying for all of us, but we were also encountering numerous bugs that playtesters had come across that made us clench our teeth, as we were just days before release. We’ll never forget how much our hearts raced upon seeing early livestreamers run into softlocks or various other strange bugs. We often had to hop in Twitch chats to explain that we were devs and that we were looking into the issues various streamers ran into right away! Thankfully, things got progressively more calming for us as the big bugs were squashed over the weeks after release. Still, nothing will ever change how anxiety-inducing the weeks leading up to release were for us.

One of the more noteworthy moments from our bugs was caught live on Twitch. We were watching German streamer Gronkh, in front of thousands of viewers getting softlocked. Amidst the chaos and chat exploding, I eventually made my presence known and give him a hotkey for getting unstuck. It ended up being very humbling as he and his community were very patient with everything, but it’s still a moment we will never ever forget.
Overall, the release of the game has been truly magical. Reviews seem to tread the line between Very Positive and Overwhelmingly Positive, and we couldn’t be more grateful. Looking back, and taking careful note of the constructive feedback given, it’s clear to see what people liked about our product, and what we could focus on bettering in the coming years with our next project. We love our community, and we couldn’t be more grateful for the amazing comments, fanart, and engagement with our game. As a couple guys out of college, this was probably the best way to kickstart our careers and hopefully deliver something in the future we’re even prouder of.

[h1][b]CONCLUSION[/b][/h1]
Time and time again we keep coming back to thank all of you. You’re all such loyal, supportive, loving, caring, and absolutely wonderful fans. We could not be where we are now, doing all sorts of new and adventurous things, if it weren’t for everyone here to follow us on this epic indie dev journey. Thank you. From the bottom of our hearts.

It would mean the world to us if you could keep spreading the word about Buddy Sim and it’s one year sale, as well as the awesome new merchandise we have out now! Keep on being the incredible community you have always been from the very start. We hope you join us on this new journey as we tackle new challenges, reach new heights, and grow our Not a Sailor Studios family together and stronger than ever before. <3

With Love,
Brandon, Vince, DeMarco, Josh

notes.title: Buddy Sim Creator Contest 2: Electric Buddyloo | Plus our next steps as a studio
notes.content:
[h3]Want to win this epic new poster? 
Read more below on the new contest and our next steps as a studio![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37298632/78d868dbdc08ce67fe258df47d062cb40b69e48c.png[/img]

Hello again everyone, it's been a while since our last big announcements! We've got some fun things to talk about including a new Creator Contest, our next steps as a company, and some teases for our next steps with Buddy Simulator.

[h1][b]Creator Contest 2: Electric Buddyloo[/b][/h1]
To celebrate Buddy Simulator's 6th month anniversary, we are holding our second Creator Contest! From those of you that were here for the first, it's going to be quite similar with just a few tweaks and some better prizes! The Buddy Sim Creator Contest 2 is all about freedom of expression! This time around, there will be no categories at all. You can make whatever your heart desires, with exceptions to the rules of course. If you are having troubles coming up with things to create, here are some example past categories that were quite popular: digital art, hand drawings, fan fiction, short stories, music, crafts, Discord emojis and stickers. Please read all of the rules below before submitting. The winners will receive some great prizes with the grand prize being a brand new Buddy Sim poster that will be signed by the devs! Check out the poster below! 

[h2]Rules:[/h2]
1. Submissions start August 18th and end September 18th
2. You can submit past forms of media you have made if you'd like, but try making something new!
3. Please limit yourself to only 2 entries for the contest and please keep it Buddy Sim related
4. In order to be counted for the contest, you either MUST use the hashtag #BSCC2 on Twitter or submit your art to our Discord or in the Steam Community Hub
5. Nothing NSFW please. Other than that, go wild and use your imagination!
6. You have our permission to use any and all Buddy Simulator related content, art, and assets only for your submissions
7. The Devs will vote of their Top 4 favorite that will receive prizes and the community will vote for the Grand Prize Winner. The Grand Prize Winner will receive a signed copy of our new Buddy Simulator poster seen above

[h1][b]Not a Sailor Studios[/b][/h1]
We have been taking the past few months to work on bug fixes, prepare for the future, and most importantly relax a bit (a lot). The team has been playing all sorts of new games and enjoying time with family and friends. But, we've always got that looming question in the back of our minds. What now? 

After 6 months of Buddy Simulator being released onto Steam and countless reviews and videos online, we are happy to say that the game has been a success. What does that mean for us now? Not a Sailor Studios will continue working on projects as a company and are extremely excited to do so! We also want to take more time into account when working on our next project instead of rushing right into things. We've made a lot of mistakes in the past and we've learned so much from them.

Yes, we will be making another game, but this time we are going to make sure we give it the time, love, and care it deserves without crunching and losing sleep over it. Don't worry, you all will be the first to know about any teases, updates, or big announcements about our work! All of this could not be possible without the love and support from the community. You all make making games worth it. We love you all more than you could ever know. Thank you everyone :)

[h1][b]What's Next?[/b][/h1]

notes.title: NEW CONTENT | STEAM TRADING CARDS AND MORE!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! It's DeMarco again here to tell you some very exciting news, and, if you keep reading, some fun little info about what we've been up to as a studio! I love writing these, and I'm very excited to bring more news to you all! :)

[h2][b]Trading Cards, Backgrounds, Badges, and Emoticons![/b][/h2]
First thing's first, we're very excited to introduce some Steam content for those of you who are interested in collecting some Buddy Simulator-related content for your Steam profile! I drew 15 cards trying my best to recapture my interpretations of the characters. It was nice using my dusty drawing tablet for a change haha!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37298632/0cb975394818f0ea11a7f3bc432ccd68cd228828.png[/img]

In addition to the trading cards, Vince put together the rest of the steam content--compiling backgrounds, some shiny badges, and reformatting some sprites we worked on for the game into fun little emoticons! It was really fun for us to revisit the game in this way, and I'm oddly very excited for this content drop. Even if it may feel small, it feels very special for us to be able to give you, our wonderful community.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37298632/f4d5bdf0feedf88cabcc0915449d24bc817ac829.jpg[/img]

[h2][b]What We've Been Up To[/b][/h2]
Whew, release has been a wild ride, and we couldn't be more thankful for the support we've been given! Since release, we've taken a few moments to return to our real lives and spend time with our families. I've been managing my finances and slowly working on the trading cards, Brandon and Vince were finishing up their degrees and each graduated college within these past couple months while working on Buddy Sim stuff on the side, and Josh has been getting ready to move in with his girlfriend as well as consistently being on top of our company emails.
In regards to the studio, we've been working at slow, comfortable paces as we recover a little from the game's development. We've been keeping up with fanart and YouTube videos and are so appreciative of all of the work you have put towards showing off our game. It's very touching and I can't describe how amazing the love has been. <3

[h2][b]The Future of Buddy Simulator 1984[/b][/h2]
While there is a lot we still need to discuss as a company regarding the future of our game and studio, we still do have plans to update the game and address the bug reports we've been getting in our forums and on our Discord. While much can't be said quite yet, we are very grateful to all of you who have taken the time to report these bugs. You have no idea how amazing it is for the patience and understanding you all have given us.

[h2][b]Q&A Saturday![/b][/h2]
Don't forget that Saturday at 2pm CDT (Chicago time) we will be hosting another Discord Q&A where you can come and chat with us, the developers! Ask us anything you like from Buddy Sim to video games to food to music. If you cannot attend the event but are still interested in all of the questions that will be asked, we will have some of our wonderful mods write down or video all of the questions after! We hope to see you then!

[h2][b]Another Huge Thank You![/b][/h2]
I probably sound like a broken record, but thank you, from the bottom of all of our hearts for the tremendous love and support you've given our game. Having Overwhelmingly Positive reviews is such a blessing, and I wish I could respond to and thank every individual person who has taken the time to review our game. Thanks again for everything, everyone. We plan on keeping in touch with our community more, hosting game nights, keeping tabs with fanart, and even doing a drawpile!  Feel free to join us, we'd love to have you :)

Love,
DeMarco, Not a Sailor Studios

notes.title: An Important Update Regarding Buddy Simulator 1984 | NEW RELEASE DATE
notes.content:
Whew, okay, DeMarco here with the difficult task of bearing the bad news! Now, for those of you who just want to see the new release date, it's [b]February 18th[/b]! And we are sticking to it, so help me, I will actually like, break my monitor on camera if we fail again (which will suck because it's brand new--THAT'S HOW SERIOUS I AM!)

We have become our worst nightmare--Cyberpunk 1984. This wasn't really an easy decision, especially since this is the third pushback to our release date since we've originally announced that we wanted to release the game in the summer last year. We want to be completely transparent with you all as to why we made this decision.
The biggest factor in this decision was our time management! When planning a project of this scale, it's important to break down every nook and cranny in development. This includes playtesting, bug fixes, and even marketing (which we didn't really give ourselves time for)! We are making great progress with the game, and while we will be able to finish it by our old deadline, we found ourselves crunching to the bone to get it out there. Believe it or not, the last thing we really have to focus on is the soundtrack, which Brandon really wants to dedicate a lot of time towards to make sure it's something he's proud of. He's also our coder. He's.... actually crazy with how much he can do! We don't want to fall into unhealthy practices to make that deadline, especially since we want the release of this to be something we're proud of. For us, a few of the things we didn't account for when budgeting our time were spending the holidays with family, sudden COVID outbreaks affecting people we love, and taking breaks for our mental health.

We've been working all day every day since the summer and we're exhausted, but gosh, we are so excited. We wouldn't have been able to do it without the wonderful support from our fans. Having such a wonderful fanbase for a studio who hasn't even released a full game yet is just... so unreal. It's both extremely wonderful and very terrifying, especially since we're brand new to game dev as a whole.

Thank you to everyone who puts up with our unprofessional indie shenanigans. We're so thankful for all of your support on this crazy game dev learning experience for us.
I think I love you...
Just kidding...
Unless...

-DeMarco
Not a Sailor Studios

notes.title: NEW NEW RELEASE DATE! | Major Buddy Simulator 1984 Update
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=a4oP-bW92i4;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]Unfortunate News[/h1]
Hey guys! We're working hard to get Buddy Sim up and running for the December 10th release date! However, we have some unfortunate news to share, so bear with us! We noticed that we were cutting content from the game in order to make the deadline, and we decided that, instead of doing so, we'd like to give ourselves one final extension to make this game the best it can be before its release. Being a small Indie studio of four college students, we're still getting a handle on scope and the process of game development as a whole, so we appreciate your patience and sticking with us since we've embarked on this crazy journey exactly a year ago! We hope pushing back the deadline one final time will make this the game something we're truly proud of. Coincidentally, Cyberpunk announcing that they were delaying their release date to December 10th is what sparked the discussion between us team members, so maybe that game coming out on that day is some sort of divine intervention telling us that we were just a little too ambitious. 



[h1]Better News/New Release Date[/h1]
After a bit of internal discussion, we think, and we hope, and we pray, that the final release date for Buddy Simulator 1984 is January 14th! We think that's the perfect amount of time for us to complete everything and gives us a bit of wiggle room to playtest and add features we previously had to cut.

Thank you all for your incredible patience, and we're sorry with being so last minute with all of this. Thanks also to our wonderful community managers  for sticking with us for so long! You guys rock. <3

With love,
Not a Sailor Boys

notes.title: GAME PRICE | Autumn Fest Postmortem
notes.content:
[h1]Steam Autumn Game Festival[/h1]
Two months ago, the four of us at Not a Sailor Studios stumbled upon an upcoming Steam event that looked all too familiar. It was the grand announcement of the Steam Autumn Game Festival! As I was ecstatic and others groaned, we we're going to apply no matter what. Despite last Steam Game Festival having quite a rocky and stressful start, we had high hopes for this one. As soon as we got the confirmation that Buddy Simulator was accepted, we got to work. We prepared many things but ultimately we made sure the stream would start at the right time and with the right game, if some of you recall the chaos of the last event.

As the day rolled around, the team was fully prepared to knock it out of the park no matter what happened. We started the stream 30 minutes early with much success. Off to a good start, we decided to chill out for a short bit and just breathe. At first, we we're getting about 25 viewers before the official start time. We would still be more than happy with that number, but we set our hopes high this time. Right as 12:00 sharp hit, the views went crazy. First 700, then 1000, moving fast to 1800, and by the time we hit our peak of the broadcast, 2700 viewers. It was incredible to see how many people came out to support us. Some old and some new! Buddy Sim even got featured in the "Live and Featured" tab of the festival! This was a dream come true. 

The stream went great and we even showed off some new footage of the 2D part of the game, that took place after where the demo ended. It was a nice little treat for all of our fans who stayed until the end. After we finished, we decided to give one more gift out to everyone. Something the community has been asking for months now: a price tag. If you've made it this far, I think you deserve to know as well! I even put it in a big font, so your eyes probably jumped right to it before reading this.

[h1]Game Price[/h1]
$9.99

We concluded the day with a wonderful Q&A session with our Discord. There were tons of wonderful questions that were asked! I won't be able to write everything down like last time, but we do have a video taken by one of our mods, DeveloperX, that is currently in the works! There is a lot of great information there from game secrets and what most embarrasses Josh the most to Brandon Sushi. You can check that out on our Discord when it is finished.

[h1]What's Next[/h1]
Great question. We have no idea. We are just going to keep working our butts off to finish the game and bring you all something fun, unique, and hopefully amazing. The four of us are staying safe and healthy in these tough times. We are all working full time on Buddy Simulator 1984 so we can deliver the best experience we can. With only two months until release, you will be seeing us a lot more! If you want to stay up to date with all of our projects, check out our social medias below! If you want some cool Buddy Simulator 1984 stickers, we have those too!

A buddy simulator to be exact! [b]Buddy Simulator 1984[/b] is the latest and greatest friend-simulation game that takes place during the 1980's when computers weren't much more than text on a screen. The game revolves around an A.I. that constantly adapts to your personality and interests in order to keep you entertained.

[h2]Talk to us about anything.[/h2]
Join Brandon (Programmer/Musician), DeMarco(Artist/Animator), Josh(Producer/Sound Design), and Vince (Artist/Graphic Designer) on a remarkable journey with their best friend [YOU DECIDE] (Best Friend/Social Media Expert) as they undergo serious complexities with a digital friendship through the likes of Guess the Number, Hangman, Rock Paper Scissors, and more.

We're planning on playing through the demo while giving a bit of commentary about the game. We're really stoked to be able to meet you guys. Feel free to ask us any questions while we play and hang out with us on Discord afterwards!

[SOMEONE] is excited to meet you. :)

[h3][b]GREETINGS NEW USER![/b][/h3]
Thanks to next-generation AI technology, [b]BUDDY SIMULATOR 1984[/b] simulates the experience of hanging out with a best buddy.

Your buddy learns from you, constantly adapting to your interests and your personality.
But most importantly, your buddy can play games with you!

[u]WARNING: Game experience may vary.[/u]

------------------------------------------------------------

BUDDY SIMULATOR 1984 is a single player, story-driven horror game revolving around a virtual best friend. The demo is roughly 30 minutes in length.
